moments.title: Sienna Spiro Tops UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Sienna Spiro has earned her first UK number-one single with 'Great Expectation', becoming the youngest British female to do so in twelve years at 20 years old.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: New UK number one! Huge congrats to Sienna Spiro on 'Great Expectation' – making history as the youngest British female to top the charts in 12 years!

angles.name: Pop Sensation
angles.copy: Sienna Spiro is officially number one with 'Great Expectation'! Tune into Nation Hits to celebrate the UK's newest pop sensation.

moments.title: Nile Rodgers is 74 Today
moments.blurb: The legendary Chic co-founder, guitarist, and producer Nile Rodgers celebrates his 74th birthday today.

angles.name: Disco Legend
angles.copy: Happy 74th to the iconic Nile Rodgers! From Chic's 'Le Freak' to producing Bowie and Madonna, his influence is unmatched. What's your favourite Nile track?

angles.name: Production Powerhouse
angles.copy: The man, the legend, Nile Rodgers turns 74! A true pioneer of funk, disco, and dance music. Spin a Chic classic with us!

moments.title: Wales Cuts Business Rates for Hospitality
